name: Mina Hubbard
source:
The near-identical twin sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c174174]Phila[/url]. Compared to her sister, Mina is very shy and meek, but is skilled at cooking. She only seems to talk to those whom she's come to trust, such as [url=https://vndb.org/c174108]Zoey[/url] and Mel. She's always seen with her sister and seems to depend heavily on her to get through the day.

[In game description]
